name: Weekly Sacrifice
source:
You are the trusted advisor to both Prince Clark and King Beaumont.

It falls to you to make sure the prince is ready for the sacrifice, but despite his familiarity with this routine, he seems more hesitant than usual.

[From [url=https://nerves-nebula.itch.io/weekly-sacrifice]itch.io[/url]]
